item.title: Bossier Parish Police Jury: February 4 meeting notes
item.description: The Bossier Parish Police Jury addressed a comprehensive agenda during its regular meeting on Feb. 4, focusing on property standards compliance, zoning matters, and administrative actions. The Jury also heard a presentation introducing the Louisiana Rouxgaroux Arena Football Team. item.description: A Shreveport man who strangled a domestic partner in April 2025 pleaded guilty in Caddo District Court on Feb. 4 and was sentenced to the maximum prison term allowed by law, three years. item.title: Caddo Parish issues parish-wide Burn Ban
item.description: A parish-wide burn ban is now in effect in Caddo Parish as of Saturday, Feb. 8, 2026, due to extremely dry conditions and a lack of significant rainfall in the long-range forecast.
